articles.title: Bank of Italy research suggests stablecoins aren't necessarily cheaper for remittances
articles.snippet: A mystery-shopping experiment found that exchange fees, foreign exchange spreads and banking rails mean stablecoin remittances are often no cheaper than traditional transfer means.

articles.title: Bitcoin mining difficulty shrinks 14% from this year's high as plunging revenues force operators to pivot
articles.snippet: Difficulty falls as weak mining economics reduce capacity, while forward markets signal little relief through year-end.

articles.title: Coinbase's weak quarter leaves Wall Street split on timing of a recovery
articles.snippet: Most analysts blamed a weak crypto market for Coinbase's earnings miss, though opinions diverged on when trading activity will recover.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs end July in the green despite late-month selling
articles.snippet: Spot Bitcoin ETFs attracted $172.4 million in July inflows but remained $5.3 billion negative year to date after heavy withdrawals in May and June.

articles.title: Tether earns $1.5B in Q2 as US Treasury holdings fuel profits
articles.snippet: Tether’s reserve surplus grew to $4.11 billion in the second quarter as USDT supply rose despite a weaker stablecoin market and continued pressure across the crypto sector.
